title: Firexy
script:
-- Firexy Hub
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Ekran GUI'si oluştur
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", playerGui)
screenGui.Name = "FirexyHub"

-- Ana Hub Çerçevesi
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", screenGui)
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 300)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -150)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"

-- Üst Başlık Barı
local topBar = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame)
topBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
topBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
topBar.BorderSizePixel = 0

-- Başlık
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", topBar)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Firexy Hub"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
title.TextSize = 18
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

-- Küçült Butonu
local minimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton", topBar)
minimizeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
minimizeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0)
minimizeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
minimizeButton.Text = "-"
minimizeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
minimizeButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
minimizeButton.TextSize = 18

-- Özellikler Menüsü
local featuresFrame = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame)
featuresFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -30)
featuresFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
featuresFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
featuresFrame.Visible = true

-- Hız Artır Butonu
local speedButton = Instance.new("TextButton", featuresFrame)
speedButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.15, 0)
speedButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.1, 0)
speedButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 200)
speedButton.Text = "Hızı Artır"
speedButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
speedButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
speedButton.TextSize = 16

-- Zıplama Yüksekliği Butonu
local jumpButton = Instance.new("TextButton", featuresFrame)
jumpButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.15, 0)
jumpButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.3, 0)
jumpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 70)
jumpButton.Text = "Zıplama Yüksekliğini Artır"
jumpButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
jumpButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
jumpButton.TextSize = 16

-- Varsayılan Ayarlara Dön Butonu
local resetButton = Instance.new("TextButton", featuresFrame)
resetButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.15, 0)
resetButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.5, 0)
resetButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 70, 70)
resetButton.Text = "Varsayılan Ayarlara Dön"
resetButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
resetButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
resetButton.TextSize = 16

-- Küçültme İşlevi
local minimized = false
minimizeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    featuresFrame.Visible = not minimized
    if minimized then
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 30)
    else
        mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 300)
    end
end)

-- Hız Artırma İşlevi
speedButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 50 -- Hız artırıldı
end)

-- Zıplama Yüksekliği İşlevi
jumpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.JumpPower = 100 -- Zıplama yüksekliği artırıldı
end)

-- Varsayılan Ayarlara Dön İşlevi
resetButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16 -- Varsayılan hız
    humanoid.JumpPower = 50 -- Varsayılan zıplama
end)
